name: spawn-error
description: A live spawn failure that throws at once: Pi is found (a file named like a program that cannot run) but starting it errors. The app reports pi:exit with the error and its errorCode, and notInstalled follows the code. Windows: spawn fails with UNKNOWN for a file that is not a program.
synthetic: Built from the record shapes the app consumes (src/renderer.js handleRecord, src/sessions.js), not from a real Pi session.
